subject.title: Feature: Per-call cost tracking & auth profile attribution

question: What safe public contract should OpenClaw use for resolved auth-profile attribution on completed model calls?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the fix would add credential-adjacent persisted metadata and gateway/plugin/UI exposure, so automation should not choose the privacy and API contract alone.

options.title: Persist safe profile ids
options.body: Store a stable non-secret authProfileId or display label on completed call metadata and aggregate usage/cost by that value in status and usage APIs.

options.title: Expose diagnostics only
options.body: Emit resolved-profile fallback events and diagnostics without persisting profile attribution into long-lived transcripts or usage summaries.

options.title: Defer to plugin seam
options.body: Keep core metadata unchanged and let a provider-owned usage plugin consume model usage once an approved profile-safe plugin contract exists.

recommendation.title: Persist safe profile ids
recommendation.body: Store a stable non-secret authProfileId or display label on completed call metadata and aggregate usage/cost by that value in status and usage APIs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-history ownership of the usage/status/diagnostic surfaces that need the exposure-boundary decision.
